items.title: Dave Robinson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2007
items.q: show their students that jazz isn’t all about Charlie Parker and beyond

ctx.x: Right. Well I hope so. And there are a lot of jazz lab band directors who are not players and don’t improvise, maybe come from a classical background, but they still, you know, wave their arms in front of a big jazz lab band, you know, so for those who are not jazzers themselves but are willing to teach it, if they have the right tools, I hope we’re
giving them the right tools here, to show their students that jazz isn’t all about Charlie Parker and beyond or John Coltrane and beyond.
Yeah, or David Sanborn and beyond.
